### Executive Summary

* National law firm Edelson Lechtzin LLP has initiated an investigation into class action claims following a data breach at Del Monte Foods.
* The security incident involved a ransomware attack that resulted in the unauthorized exposure of sensitive personal information, including Social Security numbers.
* The investigation focuses on whether Del Monte Foods adequately protected consumer and employee data prior to the ransomware incident.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause

* The root cause of the breach was identified as a ransomware attack against Del Monte Foods' IT systems.
* The precise attack vector, threat actor group, and duration of unauthorized network access are not yet confirmed.
* The technical impact includes the compromise and exfiltration of personally identifiable information (PII), specifically Social Security numbers.

### Mitigation & IOCs

* Specific technical mitigations implemented by Del Monte Foods are not yet confirmed in the source report. Standard incident response recommendations for PII exposure include identity theft monitoring, credit freezes, and credential resets.
